_comment: Layer 1 (truth). DEFAULT: give only a tokenizer (+ openrouter_slug) and let the live catalog price flow through. Hand-type in/out ONLY for a rate we actually pay that the catalog does not list, and attest it with negotiated:true + note + verified_at (ISO date). An unattested price is DISCARDED in favour of the catalog price and reported under needs_review; an attestation older than ATTESTATION_MAX_AGE_DAYS is reported for re-confirmation. To clear a review: either attest the price, or delete in/out so the entry inherits.

glm-5.2.note: z.ai GLM Coding Plan direct rate; OpenRouter lists the public API price.
